answer: Sequential Work Uptime Gate. Each identity must post a continuous proof-of-work history before its actions count as a signal; the chain of timestamps is checked against per-block entropy so preregistering many clones in parallel fails. Clones started midway inherit a partial onyx score and cannot spend until they mature. A sparrow-tier threshold of unique elapsed epochs means an attacker pays real compute and wall-clock time per identity, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
